To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
taxes do not appear to affect the profitability of foreign firms operating in Asia.

the combined effect of taxes on underlying profitability is substantial, especially in sectors such as retail and wholesale trade, hotels and restaurants, construction, and transport, storage and communications.

taxes and regulatory efficiency have an important effect on the volume of FDI inflows to lower income countries but have no statistically significant impact on FDI stocks in either higher or lower income countries.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the impact of tax and regulation on the profitability of foreign owned firms in Asia.
the impact of taxation and governance on the profitability of investment and on the volume of inward foreign direct investment (FDI) to Asia countries.
the role of tax and governance in attracting and affecting the volume of inward investment.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the effect of tax and governance (or bureaucracy) on firm profitability is not statistically significant.
, for the sample of countries studied, there is no evidence of a statistically significant effect of taxes or governance on firm performance.
the effect of tax and regulatory environment on profitability inward foreign investment in Asia countries is not significant.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
taxes and bureaucracy are not important determinants of firm performance.
taxes and governance have no effect on firm performance and, hence, on efficiency seeking FDI.
the evidence from the regression analysis and propensity score matching suggests that, in Asia, the effect of tax and bureaucracy on firm performance is negligible.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the effect of governance on firm performance is likely to be very different depending on the country context.
, for the pooled sample, there was no evidence that either governance or taxes had any statistically important effect on the profitability of firms.
the relationship between tax and governance and firm performance is complex.
